A_single_photo_reel.semantic_note: Baseline single photo reel. Six imported art fixtures; selected art1 is #3 of 6. Reel rotates to preview only; Set wallpaper is explicit.

B_asymmetric_collection_photo.semantic_note: Nested selectors: small top-right collection reel selects CollectionId only; larger bottom-left photo reel selects ImageAssetId only. Both preview, neither applies wallpaper. Same selected photo and fixture set as A.

B_compact_fallback.semantic_note: Asymmetric parent reel automatically replaced by a normal labeled collection picker when viewport height, font scale or density cannot support independent safe hit areas.

C_destinations_compact.semantic_note: Home/Lock separately chosen wallpaper photos. One active large Home photo reel; Lock preview and labeled Edit Lock affordance, not a second large hidden interactive disk. Both selected previews remain separate from actual applied wallpaper.

C_destinations_tabs_baseline.semantic_note: Conventional compact baseline for per-target Home and Lock preview: two labeled tabs, one current reel; no second decorative disk.

D_destinations_wide_dual.semantic_note: Two photo reels side by side on wide screen. Different destinations and stable independent controls; applied outcome explicit.
